note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1949: 20 nominations for the 31 seats and no contest; the eleven retiring members not nominated were deemed to be re-elected. The list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Not nominated; no one else was nominated, so the retiring councillor was deemed to be re-elected. Printed "Armaghbreague". Thomas G. Conn: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Armaghbrague, 3 October 1946, printed 'U': Frontier Sentinel, 28 September 1946, p. 5 ("Armagh Rural Council"); Armaghbrague, 5 June 1958, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Only Rural Contest in Clady")).
